lines.rom: jaya kasyapa nandana om jaya aditi nandana tribhuvana timira nikandana bhakta hrdaya candana
sapta asvaratha rajita eka cakradhari dukhahari sukhakari manasa mala hari
sura muni bhusura vamdita vimala vibhavasali agha dala dalana divakara divya kirana mali
sakala sukarma prasavita savita subhakari visva vilocana mocana bhava bamdhana bhari
kamala samuha vikasaka nasaka traya tapa sevata sahaja harata ati manasija samtapa
sakala sukarma prasavita savita subhakari visva vilocana mocana bhava bamdhana bhari
kamala samuha vikasaka nasaka traya tapa sevata sahaja harata ati manasija samtapa
netra vyadhi hara suravara bhu pira hari vrsti vimocana samtata parahita vratadhari
suryadeva karunakara aba karuna kijai hara ajnana moha saba tattvajnana dijai
